description: This file defines the CustomModesManager class responsible for managing custom modes in a VSCode extension, including loading, saving, merging, exporting, importing, and fetching organization-specific modes, with file watching and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: CustomModesManager
classes.description: Manages custom modes including loading, saving, merging, exporting, importing, and fetching organization modes, with file watching, caching, and error handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the CustomModesManager, sets up file watchers, and handles errors during setup.

methods.name: queueWrite
methods.description: Queues write operations to ensure serialized file writes.

methods.name: processWriteQueue
methods.description: Processes queued write operations sequentially.

methods.name: getWorkspaceRoomodes
methods.description: Returns the path to the .kilocodemodes file in the workspace if it exists.

methods.name: cleanInvisibleCharacters
methods.description: Removes problematic invisible characters from YAML content.

methods.name: parseYamlSafely
methods.description: Parses YAML content with error handling and fallback to JSON for .kilocodemodes files.

methods.name: loadModesFromFile
methods.description: Loads and validates modes from a specified YAML file.

methods.name: mergeCustomModes
methods.description: Merges project, global, and organization modes with precedence: organization > project > global.

methods.name: getCustomModesFilePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the custom modes file, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: watchCustomModesFiles
methods.description: Sets up file watchers for settings and .kilocodemodes files to handle changes.

methods.name: getCustomModes
methods.description: Retrieves all custom modes, utilizing cache for performance.

methods.name: updateCustomMode
methods.description: Updates or creates a custom mode, validating input and saving to appropriate file.

methods.name: updateModesInFile
methods.description: Modifies modes in a specified file using a provided operation.

methods.name: refreshMergedState
methods.description: Reloads and merges modes from files and global state, then updates cache.

methods.name: deleteCustomMode
methods.description: Deletes a mode by slug from files and associated rules folders.

methods.name: deleteRulesFolder
methods.description: Deletes the rules folder associated with a mode, handling errors.

methods.name: resetCustomModes
methods.description: Resets all custom modes to an empty list.

methods.name: checkRulesDirectoryHasContent
methods.description: Checks if a mode has any rules files with content in its directory.

methods.name: exportModeWithRules
methods.description: Exports a mode and its rules files into a YAML format for sharing.

methods.name: importRulesFiles
methods.description: Imports rules files into the mode's rules directory, validating paths.

methods.name: importModeWithRules
methods.description: Imports modes and associated rules from YAML content, with validation.

methods.name: fetchOrganizationModes
methods.description: Fetches organization-specific modes from the KiloCode API.

methods.name: refreshWithOrganizationModes
methods.description: Refreshes modes with organization-specific modes included.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears cached modes.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of file watchers and cleans up resources.
